title: ddPCR Titration of AAV Vectors
author: Addgene The Nonprofit Plasmid Repository
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b2gwqbxe
materials: Before handling any viruses get materials ready.
After the plate has been sealed, proceed to thermocycling.
Open the QuantaSoft software to set up a new plate layout. Designate the sample name, experiment type, supermix type (ddPCR Supermix for Probes), the target names and target types.

steps.title: Thaw all reagents
steps.instruction: Ensure primers, probe, 10X PCR buffer, and master mix are completely thawed.

steps.title: Vortex and spin reagents
steps.instruction: Vortex primers, probe, and master mix for 15 seconds, then spin in a mini‑centrifuge for 10 seconds and keep on ice.

steps.title: Prepare workspaces and equipment
steps.instruction: Wipe the DG8 cartridge holder with bleach and place it in the Biological Safety Cabinet (BSC). Verify that both the dilution BSC and the droplet‑generation BSC contain sufficient pipette tips and reagent reservoirs; perform viral dilutions in the dilution BSC separate from master‑mix preparation and droplet generation.

steps.title: Pre‑warm plate sealer
steps.instruction: Gently touch the screen of the 96‑well plate sealer to pre‑warm it.

steps.title: Set up dilution plate
steps.instruction: Place a 48‑well dilution plate in a chilled 96‑well freezer block and position it inside the dilution BSC.

steps.title: Add dilution buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 1X dilution buffer (recipe in reagent section) and pour it into a polystyrene reagent reservoir. Using a 20‑200 µL multichannel pipette, add the appropriate volume of buffer to each well of the dilution plate according to the dilution scheme.

steps.title: Add viral sample to first dilution
steps.instruction: Using a single‑channel 1‑10 µL pipette, add 5 µL of each viral sample to Dilution 1 (well A1) of the 48‑well plate and pipette the mixture 5–10 times to mix.

steps.title: Perform serial dilutions
steps.instruction: Create the following dilutions by adding virus to 1X PCR buffer:

substeps.instruction: Dilution 1 (1 : 20): 5 µL virus + 95 µL 1X PCR buffer
Dilution 2 (1 : 400): 5 µL from Dilution 1 + 95 µL 1X PCR buffer
Dilution 3 (1 : 8,000): 5 µL from Dilution 2 + 95 µL 1X PCR buffer
Dilution 4 (1 : 160,000): 5 µL from Dilution 3 + 95 µL 1X PCR buffer
Dilution 5 (1 : 3,200,000): 5 µL from Dilution 4 + 95 µL 1X PCR buffer
Dilution 6 (1 : 6,400,000): 50 µL from Dilution 5 + 50 µL 1X PCR buffer
Dilution 7 (1 : 12,800,000): 50 µL from Dilution 6 + 50 µL 1X PCR buffer
Dilution 8 (1 : 25,600,000): 50 µL from Dilution 7 + 50 µL 1X PCR buffer

steps.title: Mix dilutions
steps.instruction: For Dilutions 1‑5 use the 1‑10 µL multichannel pipette set to 5 µL; for Dilutions 6‑8 use the 20‑200 µL multichannel pipette set to 50 µL. Between each dilution step, use the 20‑200 µL multichannel pipette set to 90 µL and pipette up‑and‑down 10–20 times to mix.

steps.title: Seal dilution plate
steps.instruction: Gently cover the entire dilution plate with a Microseal adhesive seal without pressing the film.

steps.title: Keep dilutions chilled
steps.instruction: Leave the sealed dilution plate on the chilled 96‑well freezer block in the BSC until needed.

steps.title: Prepare ddPCR plate
steps.instruction: Place a ddPCR plate onto a chilled 96‑well freezer block and keep it in the droplet‑generation BSC to cool.

steps.title: Prepare ITR master mix
steps.instruction: In a microcentrifuge tube, prepare ITR master mix sufficient for 9 reactions (8 samples + 1 extra).

steps.title: Vortex and spin master mix
steps.instruction: Vortex the master mix for 15 seconds and spin in a mini‑centrifuge for 10 seconds before use.

steps.title: Aliquot master mix into PCR tubes
steps.instruction: Place an 8‑well PCR tube strip into a chilled 96‑well freezer block. Add 20 µL master mix to the bottom of each tube, avoiding droplets on the tube walls.

steps.title: Cap PCR tubes gently
steps.instruction: Cap each PCR tube lightly—do not push the cap fully down, just ensure the tube is covered.

steps.title: Transfer tubes to dilution BSC
steps.instruction: Move the PCR tube strip to the BSC used for dilutions.

steps.title: Add virus dilutions to reactions
steps.instruction: Without disturbing the master mix, gently uncap the tubes and add 5 µL of the appropriate virus dilution (Dilutions 6‑8) to each reaction tube. Pipette the mixture back and forth 5 times.

steps.title: Move tubes to droplet BSC
steps.instruction: Carry the PCR tube strip to the droplet‑generation BSC.

steps.title: Add water to NTC tube
steps.instruction: Without disturbing the liquid, gently uncap the tubes and add 5 µL nuclease‑free water to the No‑Template‑Control tube.

steps.title: Load cartridge with reactions
steps.instruction: Place a DG8 cartridge into its holder. Using a 2‑50 µL multichannel pipette, load 20 µL of each reaction mixture into the middle wells of the cartridge.

steps.title: Add droplet generation oil to reservoirs
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL droplet generation oil to a polystyrene reagent reservoir.

steps.title: Load oil into cartridge bottom row
steps.instruction: Using a 20‑200 µL multichannel pipette, load 70 µL droplet generation oil into the bottom row of wells of the cartridge.

steps.title: Seal cartridge with gasket
steps.instruction: Cover the cartridge with the DG8 gasket, ensuring it is securely seated.

steps.title: Generate droplets
steps.instruction: Transfer the cartridge holder to the droplet generator, close the lid, and wait for droplet generation to complete.

steps.title: Aspirate droplets
steps.instruction: Using a 20‑200 µL multichannel pipette, aspirate 40 µL of droplets from each well. Pro‑Tip: insert the tip into the centre of the well, tilt the plate 45°, and count to 20 while slowly aspirating.

steps.title: Transfer droplets to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Dispense the aspirated droplets into the pre‑chilled PCR plate. Pro‑Tip: insert the tip, gently touch the bottom, lift ~1 mm, touch the side, tilt 45°, count to 20 while slowly dispensing down the side of the well.

steps.title: Seal PCR plate with foil
steps.instruction: Place a Pierceable Foil Heat Seal on the PCR plate with the red line facing up. If the plate sealer is not at temperature, touch its screen to heat it. Once at temperature, place the foil‑covered plate onto the metal support block, insert the block into the plate sealer, and press the ‘Seal’ button.

steps.title: Run PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Run the PCR program with the specified parameters (as provided in the protocol).

steps.title: Transfer plate to droplet reader
steps.instruction: After PCR is complete, move the sealed PCR plate to the Droplet Reader.

steps.title: Read droplets
steps.instruction: When the plate layout is complete in the reader software, select ‘Run’ to start droplet reading.

steps.title: Export data and calculate titer
steps.instruction: When droplet reading finishes, export all well data as a CSV file. Calculate vector titer using T = [(R × C) × 1000 / V] × D, where T = GC/mL, R = reaction volume (20 µL), C = copies/µL, V = virus volume in reaction (4 µL), and D = dilution factor of the virus.
